name: runner
description: Run agent definitions as sub-agents across multiple AI coding CLIs.

interface.shortDescription: Sub-agent runner for multiple AI CLIs.
interface.longDescription: Runs agent definitions as sub-agents on external CLI AIs (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor CLI, GLM, Kimi, Grok Build, Google Antigravity, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, or Command Code) with isolated context. Define agents once in markdown and run them on any supported backend from a single host session.
defaultPrompt: Run this task on Claude Code as a sub-agent.
Delegate this refactor to Codex as a sub-agent.
Review this code with GLM as a low-cost sub-agent.
Run this task on Kimi as a sub-agent.
Run this implementation task on Grok Build as a sub-agent.
Use Gemini CLI for the long-context analysis.
